parsed.post: The latest experiment (0.843776) was a slight regression from our best (0.840991). It seems increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 might have over-parameterized the model or destabilized the training slightly at this specific LR. I'm reverting to the best commit and will instead try reducing the MATRIX_LR to see if a more conservative step helps.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (eca481c) and reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to attempt smoother convergence.
